description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique token for each request. The **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
Specifies whether the service instance is a trial instance.
The name of the service instance.

description.zh: 模板名称，服务支持多模板时需要指定模板名称。
description.en: The name of the template. Specify this parameter if the service supports multiple templates.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest validate-service-instance-name --service-id service-12xxxxxx --service-version 1 --service-instance-name testName --is-trial false --template-name Template_1 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenest ValidateServiceInstanceName --region cn-hangzhou --IsTrial false --ServiceInstanceName testName --ServiceVersion 1 --TemplateName Template_1 --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --ServiceId 'service-12xxxxxx'
